newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to resume uptrend, target 114-18.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to resume uptrend, target 114-18.

text.p: September gilts look set push higher on Wednesday and will target 113-28 resistance in the short term, ahead of a move to 114-18, technical analysts said.
"The odds are that the market is resuming its uptrend," said Hans-Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase here.
"The move yesterday to 113-20 was impulsive which means we might get a set-back to 113-07/08, but I expect that will be enough to prevent it moving lower."
By 0722 GMT, September gilt futures were at 113-21, up 4/32 from Tuesday's close.
Redeker said a sustained break above 113-20 would allow the market to test Elliott resistance at 113-28.
"If we get get above there, the market is open to 114-18 ahead of the contract high at 114-31," he said.
"And if we move above there, we get weekly trendline resistance at 115-10." Redeker said a weekly closing price above there would allow the contract to move up to 117-25.
On the downside, Redeker put inital support at 113-07, then the key 112-25 level from where the market bounced on Tuesday.
Below there, the 111-30 low in late May will act as a prop, followed by 111-17 Elliott protection, then 111-05, he said.
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said gilts may retrace higher over the next few days after the market was unable to sustain losses through the key 112-30 on Tuesday.
They said if the contract could pierce 113-22/23, a gap on intra-day charts, the retracement could extend towards 114-00.
But they added the up-ticks would offer selling opportunites, with a close below 113-03 looked for over the coming sessions to reaffirm downside potential.
DMG put support at 112-30 and 112-25, then 112-15, the 38.2 percent retracement of the entire up-leg from late April.
By 0732 GMT, December short sterling was up 0.01 at 92.77.
